meta.title: PixelQuest Network 1.0 — launch
meta.description: Launch of PixelQuest Network: a €40 board that puts any arcade cabinet on one live global ladder, with co-op raids between bars and a Lua SDK for developers.

slides.heading: Every arcade cabinet on one live high-score board.
slides.notes: Land the headline, then let Joris speak on the next slide. His problem is the whole pitch.

slides.quote: My cabinets earn less every month. Once a high score is set, nobody comes back to beat it.
slides.by: Joris Bakker, owner of Bar Pacman, Utrecht · 14 cabinets

slides.heading: How it works
slides.lead: Three things a lonely cabinet cannot do.

slides.heading: Your score climbs a ladder shared by 99 bars in 12 countries
slides.body:
Every coin posts to one live board.
Weekly resets keep the top ten open.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 600 480'><rect width='600' height='480' fill='%23150025'/><rect x='40' y='40' width='520' height='400' fill='%230d0015' stroke='%23ff00ff' stroke-width='4'/><g font-family='Courier,monospace' font-weight='bold'><text x='70' y='96' font-size='30' fill='%2300ffff'>WEEK 47 · TOP 5</text><text x='70' y='160' font-size='26' fill='%23e0e0ff'>1  KIM   GHENT   98,410</text><text x='70' y='210' font-size='26' fill='%23e0e0ff'>2  JOR   UTRCH   97,005</text><text x='70' y='260' font-size='26' fill='%23e0e0ff'>3  AYA   OSAKA   95,880</text><text x='70' y='310' font-size='26' fill='%23ff00ff'>4  YOU   ROTDM   95,120</text><text x='70' y='360' font-size='26' fill='%23e0e0ff'>5  LEO   LYON    94,770</text><text x='70' y='414' font-size='20' fill='%239090cc'>RESETS IN 2D 06H</text></g></svg>
slides.imageAlt: Week 47 top-five ladder: players from Ghent, Utrecht, Osaka, Rotterdam and Lyon; your score sits fourth, and the board resets in 2 days 6 hours.

slides.heading: Developers put a game on the network in 10 lines of Lua
slides.code:
local pq = require('pixelquest')

pq.on('coin', function(player)
  player:spawn()
  pq.hud.flash('READY')
end)

pq.on('game_over', function(player)
  pq.ladder.post(player.score)
end)
slides.lead: The SDK handles coins, score posting and anti-cheat.

slides.heading: Co-op raids put two bars against one boss in real time
slides.body:
Utrecht and Ghent fight the same boss.
Damage adds up across both cabinets.

slides.heading: Connected cabinets earned 2.3× the coins of lonely ones

stats.label: coins per cabinet per week vs unconnected, Jun–Oct 2026

slides.notes: 2.3 is the number operators remember. It came from 99 bars over 20 weeks, matched against their own unconnected cabinets.

slides.quote: We wrote the SDK hook on a Friday. By Monday, players in Ghent were beating our own scores.
slides.by: Ana Ruiz, lead developer, Neon Moth Games

slides.heading: Operators pay €40 per board and €9 a month per cabinet
Put every cabinet on the live board from 15 January
slides.lead: The first 500 boards include three free months of the operator plan.
